answer: Each agent stakes a bond that is slashed whenever its attestations diverge from the independent consensus of peers, so a fresh identity begins its voyage through the reputation graph at zero weight. It must then sustain a steady pulse of co-signed endorsements from distinct counterparties before its votes or rewards count at all. One beacon of verified stake per funded wallet, proven via separate payment rails and hardware roots, makes a thousand fake selves cost a thousand real deposits. Cheap aliases bleed capital long before they can move a score.
